goals: Make every eligible BGE-derived geometry resolve to the selected Complementary shader material classification of its canonical parent, so changing geometry does not silently change material identity.
Use BGE's authoritative canonical binding and a supported Complementary/Iris integration seam rather than a second manually maintained inventory of derived block IDs.
Preserve Translucent Glass as a representative clear-glass compatibility control while covering the broader Complementary material contract.
scope: Audit and coordinate parent-material parity for BGE's canonical full blocks and their available slab, stair, wall, Vertical Slab, Step, Layer, Corner, Quarter Column, and equivalent derived roles.

Cover shader-ID classes and their associated reflective, smooth/specular, emissive, translucent/Fancy Glass, foliage, and other material behaviors only where the parent classification and the physical derived geometry make that inheritance meaningful.

Use the exact supplied Complementary Unbound r5.8.1 archive and saved shader options as read-only audit inputs; record a precise supported implementation plan when current Workbench-owned code cannot complete parity.
Retain the former project's Translucent Glass findings, especially ordinary resource/CTM composition, translucent render-layer and face-culling concerns, and the boundary with BGE × CTM.

exclusions: BGE × CTM UUID 5747a309-1bd5-4280-b25c-98669e149928 retains Continuity connection, overlay, canonical-appearance, and physical-contact policy; this project neither duplicates nor broadens that work.

Block Geometry Extensions and Nibaru retain canonical bindings, geometry registration, model generation, render-layer correctness, and physical surface/culling ownership; a BGE change is considered only after a supported shader-material contract is agreed.
The immutable originals/shaderpacks reference archive and its saved configuration are never modified, copied into artifacts, or redistributed as a patched shader pack.

No Iris mixin, private renderer hook, generated per-derived-block mapping, resource-pack-side shader override, or speculative shader-pack patch is an accepted implementation path without documented upstream support and licensing permission.
Minecraft runtime validation, release artifacts, Canary versions, deployment, and unrelated project status are outside this rescope/audit task.

dependencies.reason: BGE C78 is the audited owner of authoritative BgeMaterialBindings, canonical parent/state projection, texture roles, and exact derived-geometry surface topology.
BGE × CTM owns the separate Fabric appearance bridge and Continuity contact policy that composes with, but does not supply, Iris shader material IDs.
Iris reads the selected shader pack's block.properties mappings and provides the documented tag syntax available to a shader-pack author.
Exact user-supplied read-only reference pack whose block.properties material mapping and enabled Fancy Glass setting define this audit target.
Its clear-glass resource treatment remains a representative texture/CTM control, not the defining shader-material scope.

state.milestone: Static rescope and architecture audit complete against BGE C78, BGE × CTM Canary 12, the exact Complementary Unbound r5.8.1 archive, and the supplied Fancy Glass-enabled configuration. BGE has the parent authority; Iris accepts pack-declared IDs/tags, but this exact pack has only explicit block mappings and no supported Workbench-only path to change its material IDs. No implementation or runtime validation has begun.
